layoutApproach: Persistent left sidebar (root/dir tree) + content grid (gallery/list toggle) + topbar search + right drawers (project/agent, mutually exclusive). Command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K) added as a navigation accelerator overlay on top of the sidebar, not a replacement.

responsive.mobile: Sidebar becomes hamburger overlay; drawers slide in from right; batch bar becomes bottom sheet; gallery single column.
responsive.tablet: Sidebar collapsible to icon rail (root select + dir tree); main grid 2-3 columns with infinite scroll.
responsive.desktop: Full sidebar (root select + dir tree), gallery/list toggle, up to 6-8 column grid with virtualization, right drawers exclusive.

interactionMap.fileSearchBtn/contentSearchBtn: global recursive filename / ripgrep content search
